people.name: Amalek
people.line: A nomadic people, descendants of Esau, enemies of Israel.

translations.web: He said to me, ‘Who are you?’ I answered him, ‘I am an Amalekite.’
translations.bsb: ‘Who are you?’ he asked. So I told him, ‘I am an Amalekite.’
translations.kjv: And he said unto me, Who art thou? And I answered him, I am an Amalekite.
translations.asv: And he said unto me, Who art thou? And I answered him, I am an Amalekite.
